outline: 本門課內容包括以下﹕能量與動力原理，燃料與燃燒簡介，鍋爐與熱交換器簡介，渦輪機與內燃機，核能與水力發電動力廠
schedule:
週數	Date	Chap. No.	Chapter name

1	2/23		開學
2, 3	3/2, 3/9	2, 3, 4, 5	Review: Energy, Energy Transfer, and General Energy Analysis (The First Law of Thermodynamics); Properties of Pure Substances; Energy analysis of Closed Systems; Mass and Energy Analysis of Control Volumes
4	3/16	6	The Second Law of Thermodynamics (Heat Engines; Reversible and Irreversible Processes; Carnot Cycle; Carnot Heat Engine)
5	3/23	7	Entropy (Entropy; Isentropic Processes; Entropy change of Liquids, Solids and Ideal Gases)
6	3/30	8	Exergy: A Measure of Work Potential (Exergy Change of a System; Exergy Transfer by Heat, Work, and Mass; Exergy Balance)
7, 8	4/6, 4/13	9	Gas Power Cycles (Otto Cycle, Diesel Cycle)
9	4/20 期中考		Midterm Exam
10, 11	4/27, 5/4	9	Gas Power Cycles [Stirling and Ericsson Cycles; Brayton Cycles (The Ideal Cycle for Gas-Turbine Engine)]
12, 13, 14, 15	5/11, 5/18, 5/25, 6/1	10	Vapor and Combined Power Cycles (The Carnot Vapor Cycle; Energy Analysis of the Ideal Rankine Cycle, Actual Vapor Power Cycles, The Ideal Reheat Rankine Cycle, The Ideal Regenerative Rankine Cycle)
16, 17	6/8, 6/15	11	綠建築 / 能源管理
18	6/22 期末考		Final Exam
assessment:
課本每章本文之例題以及文後之習題中有附答案部分，有助教演習課，優先列入期中考與期末考範圍
評分： 小考 20 分 (Optional); 期中考 40分; 期末考 40分
